name: SK Rapid
notes: Nuxt SPA with no server-rendered data; pulls fixtures from the WP REST API at cms.skrapid.at/wp-json/wp/v2/match (paginated, 100/page) plus wp/v2/competition for category names. Covers all SK Rapid squads (men, women, youth, 2nd team), not just the Bundesliga side. No per-match detail page resolves on the public site, so url points to the general schedule page for every record.
